purpose: Freeze literal TopK10/9/8/7 quantity controls and the future per-query count-matched random/bottom-rank generator protocol without evaluating a Selector.

topk_controls.construction: Each smaller system is the literal S0 prefix; ranks 11-20 never replace a deleted item.
topk_controls.chain_denominator: queries whose TopK10 contains every official gold document
topk_controls.harm_metrics_scope: NIAH only; 2Wiki has no harmful labels

paired_statistics.alignment: strict identical query keys and identical metric masks
paired_statistics.p_value: two-sided Monte Carlo component sign-flip with plus-one correction

count_matched_control.nesting: within a query and repeat, the m-drop set is a prefix of one frozen priority order
count_matched_control.reason: The control must copy each query's actual Selector deletion count; R003 has no Selector trace and therefore must not fabricate count-matched outcomes.
